contract: GET /api/items/:id/download: canDownload gate (sendStatus 403), single-file items stream with configured audio mime and attachment disposition, directory items stream STORE-mode zip named '<media title>.zip' (upstream zips with zlib level 0), disk errors 404 'File not found' / 500 'Download failed' until headers sent

invariants.contract: Directory download produces a zip whose entries (name/size/CRC32) match upstream exactly; both zippers use STORE mode so CRC equality proves byte-equal content; response streams chunked without Content-Length.
canDownload=false → sendStatus(403) with the express 'Forbidden' text body; api keys resolve to their user (TokenManager.js:277-305) and do NOT merge key permissions into the runtime user.

For GET /api/items/:id/file/:fileid/download, upstream middleware resolves the library file before downloadLibraryFile checks canDownload: a missing file ID returns sendStatus(404), while a valid file ID with download permission disabled returns sendStatus(403).

If the requested library-file record exists but its disk path is missing with ENOENT, upstream returns 404 'File not found'; a previously selected audio MIME type is preserved with Express string charset, Content-Length, and weak ETag headers.

exceptions: Single-file item download (isFile=1 items at library root) is implemented per source (mime + res.download semantics) but has no differential case yet.
Download-after-media-change state variant recorded for the next expansion wave.
